texts.content: {"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 0.85, 0.1]}}}, "range": [0, 14], "size": 11.5, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}], "font": {"id": "7244518590332801592", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "逢人只说三分话，后半句才是根"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 9], "size": 11.0, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}], "font": {"id": "7244518590332801592", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "整句是《增广贤文》"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 7], "size": 11.0, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}], "font": {"id": "7244518590332801592", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "未可全抛一片心"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 0.9]}}}, "range": [0, 7], "size": 11.5, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}], "font": {"id": "7244518590332801592", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "话说三分留七分"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 9], "size": 11.0, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}], "font": {"id": "7244518590332801592", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "它不是教咱虚情假意"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 8], "size": 11.0, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}], "font": {"id": "7244518590332801592", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "是教咱说话留分寸"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 3], "size": 11.0, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}], "font": {"id": "7244518590332801592", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "三样话"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 8], "size": 11.0, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}], "font": {"id": "7244518590332801592", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "关系再好也少往外"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 9], "size": 11.0, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}], "font": {"id": "7244518590332801592", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "说：一是家里的难处"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 8], "size": 11.0, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}], "font": {"id": "7244518590332801592", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "说出去换不来帮忙"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 5], "size": 11.0, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}], "font": {"id": "7244518590332801592", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "只换来笑话"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 0.9]}}}, "range": [0, 7], "size": 11.5, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}], "font": {"id": "7244518590332801592", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "话说三分留七分"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 7], "size": 11.0, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}], "font": {"id": "7244518590332801592", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "二是儿女的私事"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 8], "size": 11.0, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}], "font": {"id": "7244518590332801592", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "他们有他们的日子"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 7], "size": 11.0, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}], "font": {"id": "7244518590332801592", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "三是别人的短处"}

{"styles": [{"fill": {"alpha": 1.0, "content": {"render_type": "solid", "solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [1.0, 1.0, 1.0]}}}, "range": [0, 9], "size": 11.0, "bold": true, "italic": false, "underline": false, "strokes": [{"content": {"solid": {"alpha": 1.0, "color": [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]}}, "width": 0.08000000000000002}], "font": {"id": "7244518590332801592", "path": "D:"}}], "text": "明天就传回他耳朵里"}
